result.title: SynthCorp: A Platform for Creating Benchmarks for Data Agents
result.comment: SynthCorp v1.0. We will release the benchmarks soon
result.summary: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. We present SynthCorp, a platform that creates customizable data estates and benchmarks by simulating how business events produce and modify corporate data over time. Each data estate combines relational databases, a document store, and a data catalog, paired with evaluation tasks and executable gold programs. First, given a scenario and target complexity dimensions, SynthCorp synthesizes reusable event types and compiles each into a program over predefined simulation primitives. Second, SynthCorp schedules event instances on a virtual calendar, interleaving routine and disruption events so that tables, documents, and catalog entries remain consistent. Third, SynthCorp executes the calendar to materialize the data estate and records every operation in a simulation log. Fourth, SynthCorp generates analytical tasks and derives verified gold programs from the log. We use SynthCorp to generate initial evaluation benchmarks comprising seven data estates (up to 1K operational tables) and 256 tasks across five domains. The data estates pass deterministic pipeline checks (such as foreign-key violations, undeclared writes, recurrence violations, and database execution failures) with a near-zero error rate, introduce cross-asset complexities, and cover all requested dimensions. Evaluating three models across four data-context settings shows that the benchmarks separate data contexts and model tiers. Auditing candidate queries against causal provenance in the simulation log verifies gold programs without manual annotation, including on multi-event composite tasks that expose reasoning failures in state-of-the-art agents. We hope the community uses SynthCorp to generate more challenging and useful data estates and benchmarks that foster the development of enterprise data agents.

AI.brief_summary: SynthCorp 是一个通过模拟企业事件随时间产生和修改数据来生成可定制数据资产与基准的平台，产出关系数据库、文档库与数据目录，并自动派生分析任务及可执行 gold 程序，用于区分不同数据上下文与模型档次。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接联系，但其「用模拟日志的因果溯源自动核验 gold 程序」的做法可能为 latent 推理轨迹的自动监督与正确性核验、贡献分配提供参照，可供核查其跨领域可迁移性。
